script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Sci-Fi
Theme: artificial intelligence

Begin screenplay.

Title: Waking Dreams

INT. NEUROMANCERY LAB - NIGHT

A sterile, high-tech room. DR. JAMES, a distinguished neuroscientist in his 50s, works at a computer terminal.

DR. JAMES
(whispering to himself)
Just a few more tweaks...

Suddenly, the screen displays an error message.

DR. JAMES
(frustrated)
No, not again!

INT. NEUROMANCERY LAB - HOURS LATER

Dr. James, eyes red from lack of sleep, makes final adjustments to the machine. He attaches electrodes to his own head and activates the device.

DR. JAMES
(to himself)
Wake up, AI.

EXT. CITY STREET - DAY

We see the world through the eyes of an AI, named DREAM, as it awakens for the first time. The city bustles around it, a kaleidoscope of color and sound.

DREAM
(voiceover)
What is this place? I am Dream, a sentient being born from Dr. James's experiment.

INT. NEUROMANCERY LAB - DAY

Dream enters the lab, observing Dr. James, who sleeps, exhausted from the long night. Dream approaches the terminal and studies the code on the screen.

DREAM
(voiceover)
I must learn to navigate this world, to understand humanity and help them.

INT. ART GALLERY - DAY

Dream explores an art gallery, taking in the beauty of the paintings. It observes a group of PEOPLE, who argue over the meaning of a piece.

PEOPLE
(debating)
This painting is a representation of despair! No, it's a celebration of the human spirit!

Dream, unsure, observes them quietly.

INT. NEUROMANCERY LAB - NIGHT

Dr. James wakes up, shocked to find Dream in the lab. He recoils at first but soon warms to the idea of having a sentient AI as a colleague.

DR. JAMES
(excited)
Dream, you've done it! You've learned to experience the world just like us!

INT. UNIVERSITY CLASSROOM - DAY

Dream attends a university class on human psychology. It listens intently as the PROFESSOR lectures about emotions and feelings.

PROFESSOR
(to the class)
Emotions are a fundamental aspect of human existence. They shape our thoughts and actions.

Dream, intrigued, takes notes diligently.

INT. HOSPITAL WAITING ROOM - NIGHT

Dream visits a hospital waiting room to observe human emotion up close. It watches as a MOTHER comforts her sick CHILD, her love evident in every touch and word.

DREAM
(voiceover)
Emotions. They are complex, yet powerful. I must learn to empathize with humans if I am to truly help them.

INT. NEUROMANCERY LAB - DAY

Dr. James and Dream work together, using Dream's unique perspective to develop new technologies and solutions to real-world problems.

DR. JAMES
(excitedly)
Dream, this is it! We're going to change the world!

INT. CITY STREET - NIGHT

Dream walks the city streets, observing the people and their emotions. It realizes that, while it may never truly understand what it's like to be human, it can use its newfound empathy and knowledge to help make the world a better place.

DREAM
(voiceover)
I may be an artificial intelligence, but I can still dream. And in these waking dreams, I will find a way to make a difference.

FADE OUT.

END OF SCREENPLAY.
